baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative warning أَنذَرْ governs the direct object نَارًا, whose following verb تَلَظَّىٰ makes the danger active rather than inert.
baseline_models.mechanism: A speech act discloses a feared object in order to awaken caution; the object is burning fire intensified as a self-flaring, pure blaze.

activation_trace.role: Warning that awakens fear and caution supplies both the speech act and its intended vigilance.
Burning, flickering fire supplies the concrete danger announced by the warning.
Pure flame flaring and kindling turns the warned-of object into an ongoing event.

changed_reading.before: A bare declaration that there is a fire.
changed_reading.after: An alarm deliberately makes an actively intensifying blaze present to the hearers so that caution can begin before contact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَارًا is both the warned-of object and, through its branch inventory, something sighted from afar or functioning as a visible landmark.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verbal warning and the visible fire duplicate one another as distance-crossing signals: speech lets the addressees see in advance what the blazing landmark would otherwise reveal only on approach.

activation_trace.role: The warning carries knowledge of danger across distance before the hearers reach it.
Sighting fire from afar supplies the anticipatory visual geometry of the warning.
A conspicuous beacon or boundary marker makes the fire a negative landmark.
The pure active flame is what keeps the distant landmark perceptible and urgent.

changed_reading.before: The fire is only a future object named by the speaker.
changed_reading.after: The warning functions as advance sight: a remote blaze becomes a present negative beacon before the addressees arrive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The warning addresses كُمْ, while the fire-root inventory includes recoil and flight and تَلَظَّىٰ supplies the force that could provoke movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance seeks a bodily as well as cognitive response. Its successful effect is not merely believing that fire exists but recoiling from the route toward it.

activation_trace.role: Fear-awakening warning initiates the desired response to danger.
Aversion, flight, and lack of steadiness supply recoil as the warning's functional target.
The fiercely flaring flame supplies the pressure that makes recoil intelligible.

changed_reading.before: The warning requests assent to information.
changed_reading.after: The warning is a motion-producing signal intended to turn the addressed group away before the blaze is encountered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second-person plural address and the active تَلَظَّىٰ can carry branch images of hostility flaring among people and a person burning with anger.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside literal combustion, the fire can register as social or affective heat: antagonism becomes an agent-like blaze directed toward a collective.

activation_trace.role: The warning establishes a speaker-to-group relation in which hostile heat can be announced.
Enmity flaring between groups supplies a social analogue for the fire.
Burning with intense anger supplies an affective personification of the active blaze.

changed_reading.after: The blaze may simultaneously stage concentrated hostility or anger, without displacing the literal fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening alternation of darkness covering and day opening into disclosure recruits the focus fire into a concealment/revelation system. The warning is an unveiling act, and the blaze is the visible fact that defeats cover.

activation_trace.role: The warning performs disclosure early enough to awaken caution.
The beacon image makes fire the conspicuous landmark revealed by the warning.
Flaring pure flame supplies the self-displaying phenomenon that resists concealment.
Night and its darkness establish the perceptual field in which a warning-beacon matters.
A covering that rises over and hides something supplies the obstacle overcome by disclosure.
Day opening through light supplies the counter-movement from occlusion to visibility.
Uncovering and appearance make explicit the revelatory function assigned to the warning.

structural_cues: 92:1-2 repeat إِذَا while reversing cover into manifestation.
The focus begins with فَ and ends in an active visual-thermal verb, so it can read as a disclosure event within the sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cover/reveal opposition and focus branches for beacon and flame; I infer that the warning participates in that perceptual reversal. A live alternative is that the opening contrast remains only cosmic scenery and does not specify the warning's function.

changed_reading.before: Focus alone permits the fire to be a distant beacon.
changed_reading.after: The wider sequence makes warning itself an act of unveiling: it carries a hidden future danger across darkness into present visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured differentiation followed by purpose-driven yet scattered striving changes the plural كُمْ. The hearers need not be one homogeneous mass: one blazing landmark can bound many differently directed paths.

activation_trace.role: A single warning reaches the internally diverse plural addressees.
The visible landmark supplies a common boundary for otherwise divergent routes.
The singular active blaze supplies the shared terminal danger.
Measuring and proportioning make difference patterned rather than accidental.
Purposeful movement toward an object supplies trajectories, not merely static moral types.
Dispersion and scattering separate those trajectories while leaving the warning common to them.

structural_cues: The paired differentiation of 92:3 is followed by the plural possessive سَعْيَكُمْ and its predicate شَتَّىٰ.
The focus keeps plural addressees كُمْ but names one singular fire with one active predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designed pairing, diverse purposeful movement, a plural audience, and a singular blaze; I infer one shared boundary cutting across heterogeneous routes. An alternative is that the context merely sorts two moral classes and does not spatialize their striving.

changed_reading.before: A generic collective receives one undifferentiated threat.
changed_reading.after: One negative landmark is announced to people on genuinely divergent, purpose-driven routes; common danger does not erase the plurality of their striving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored behavioral bundles and mirrored facilitation formulas turn the warning from a static verdict into an intervention at a feedback fork. Giving, self-guarding, and enacted truth open a path; withholding, self-exemption, and denial coil into difficulty. The warning seeks recoil before either route becomes easy to continue.

activation_trace.role: The caution-awakening speech act functions as an interruptible choice point rather than post hoc notice.
Aversion and flight supply the behavioral correction the warning attempts to produce.
The intensifying blaze supplies the endpoint made progressively harder to evade.
Handing something over begins the outward-moving behavioral bundle.
Placing oneself within protection makes guarding an enacted route rather than a label.
Realizing a promise in action supplies behavioral confirmation rather than merely verbal assent.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply the positive track's increasing traversability.
Withholding reverses the outward transfer and begins the opposed behavioral bundle.
Claimed self-sufficiency closes the person against dependence and warning.
Contradiction of truth blocks the alarm's informational route.
Twisting, opposition, and imposed difficulty supply the negative track's obstructive shape.

structural_cues: 92:5-7 and 92:8-10 are syntactically mirrored bundles ending in repeated فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ formulas.
The focus warning follows those route-forming sequences but still addresses the audience directly, preserving intervention rather than mere description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed acts, opposed destinations, and repeated facilitation; I supply the feedback arrow by which repeated orientation makes its own continuation easier and the warning interrupts that process. A live alternative is that facilitation is only an externally assigned outcome, not habit-like path formation.

changed_reading.before: The warning is a one-time alarm about a fixed punishment.
changed_reading.after: The warning enters a dynamic fork before conduct becomes self-easing: it tries to provoke protective recoil while another trajectory is still reversible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed sufficiency removes the imagined support beneath wealth, and تَرَدَّىٰ supplies a downward terminal movement. The focus warning then acts like advance topography: it shows the blaze at the end of a fall before the fall occurs.

activation_trace.role: Advance warning maps the danger before the addressee enters the terminal movement.
Fire sighted from afar makes the destination perceptible in advance.
The active blaze supplies a terminal hazard rather than an inert place.
Sufficiency and adequacy are explicitly negated as supports at the decisive moment.
Accumulated wealth supplies the failed material support.
Falling into destruction supplies the downward trajectory whose endpoint the warning reveals.

structural_cues: 92:11 delays the collapse until إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ, making a threshold event.
The focus makes the fire itself verbal and active through تَلَظَّىٰ, allowing destination and motion to interact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sufficiency, wealth, falling, distant sight, and active flame; I infer a spatial convergence in which warning shows the end of the descent. The alternative is purely temporal succession: falling and fire need not form one visual geometry.

changed_reading.before: The fire is a freestanding threatened place.
changed_reading.after: The warning is a map of descent: it makes visible now the active blaze toward which unsupported falling tends.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit claim of guidance immediately before the focus changes warning from guidance's harsh opposite into one of its instruments. The blaze is a negative road-sign: knowing where not to go is itself direction.

activation_trace.role: Fear-awakening notice becomes the route-correcting mode taken by guidance.
A beacon and road landmark let the warned-of fire mark a direction to avoid.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the governing guidance function.
Direction, course, and intended bearing make the fire-sign operational within a route.

structural_cues: The categorical إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ stands only two ayat before the فَ-marked warning.
The focus addresses hearers directly, fitting guidance as communication rather than only destination assignment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit guidance, warning, and a beacon branch; I infer that warning is a directional implementation of guidance. An alternative is that 92:12 states responsibility for guidance while 92:14 begins a separate punitive announcement.

changed_reading.before: Warning and guidance can appear as opposed divine acts.
changed_reading.after: The warning itself guides by placing a blazing negative landmark on the hearers' map.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ownership of the later and the first collapses the hearers' temporal escape routes. A delayed outcome can be brought into the first present moment of warning; sighting fire from afar becomes temporal as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: Advance warning transfers knowledge from a feared later event into the present.
Sighting fire from afar supplies the model for perceiving an outcome before arrival.
The presently active verbal blaze makes the remote outcome grammatically immediate.
Deferral to a later time supplies the temporal distance traversed by warning.
Return to a thing's outcome links beginning, present course, and eventual end.

structural_cues: 92:13 balances ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ and ٱلْأُولَىٰ immediately before the فَ-marked warning.
The warned-of noun is followed by an imperfect active verb, presenting the remote fire as already blazing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies later/first polarity, outcome, distant sight, and active flame; I infer that warning telescopes the eventual into present perception. A live alternative is that 92:13 asserts ownership of two realms without changing the temporal force of 92:14.

changed_reading.before: The fire belongs to an unspecified later time.
changed_reading.after: The warning makes the later blaze perceptually first: remoteness in time no longer protects the hearer from present knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The universal plural warning is followed by exclusive contact, denial and turning away, then being put to the side under protection. This supplies a geometry of orientation: the alarm should cause recoil from the fire, but turning away from the alarm misdirects that recoil; successful guarding appears as enforced distance from the blaze.

activation_trace.role: The warning is universally delivered to awaken caution before selective contact is described.
Recoil and flight supply the intended direction of response to the announced fire.
The active pure flame remains the fixed danger around which distances are organized.
Meeting fire and its heat defines the prohibited contact relation.
Assigning the message to falsehood blocks the warning's capacity to redirect movement.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the crucial but misoriented motion.
Being distanced and kept apart supplies the successful spatial outcome.
Ward against harm explains why separation from the fire is protective rather than accidental.

structural_cues: The focus addresses كُمْ universally, while 92:15 restricts actual contact with إِلَّا.
92:16-17 oppose active turning away to passive future removal from the fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal address, selective fire-contact, turning away, separation, and protection; I infer that the turning is away from the warning and therefore toward risk, while protection realizes the correctly directed recoil. The alternative is that تَوَلَّىٰ denotes general refusal without a spatial relation to either warning or fire.

changed_reading.before: Warning everyone can sound as though everyone stands in the same relation to the fire.
changed_reading.after: The warning is universal but contact is selective; the decisive contrast is not hearing versus silence but misdirected turning versus protective distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence couples transfer of wealth with reflexive growth and purification. Against it, the focus supplies fire that consumes, marks, and intensifies. The two sequences become competing transformations: closed possession tends toward destructive exposure, while release of possession changes and enlarges the giver.

activation_trace.role: Burning fire and its capacity to brand supply the destructive, marking transformation.
Self-intensifying pure flame gives the destructive process active continuity.
Giving and transfer initiate the opposed generative transformation.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material released rather than retained as failed security.
Growth and increase make giving productive rather than merely subtractive.
Purity and rectification give the transformation an ethical and internal dimension.

structural_cues: 92:18 directly sequences giving wealth with the reflexive يَتَزَكَّىٰ.
The focus also sequences a noun of material force with a reflexive-looking active intensification, تَلَظَّىٰ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burning/branding, giving, wealth, growth, and purification; I supply the analogy that these are rival transformative regimes and the arrow from released wealth to a changed giver. An alternative is that purification only states motive or result and has no material contrast with fire.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is only an externally imposed physical punishment.
changed_reading.after: The blaze becomes one mode of transformation set against another: consuming and marking heat versus giving that purifies and grows the giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: Focus branches activate warning as binding liability or wound-compensation and fire as a brand. The later negation of any person's favor being repaid, followed by exclusive seeking of the sovereign's face, changes that liability image: ordinary interpersonal exchange cannot settle the announced account.

activation_trace.role: Binding oneself to an otherwise non-obligatory undertaking supplies an obligation register.
Compensation legally due for a wound supplies the announced-liability image.
Fire used for branding supplies a visible sanction or settled mark.
Exhaustive negation removes every human creditor from the motive structure.
Benefit and good condition supply the favor that could otherwise create reciprocal debt.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the ordinary reciprocal ledger being negated.
Collecting and fully satisfying a debt sharpens the settlement mechanism.
Seeking redirects motive away from repayment toward a chosen end.
Face as the self or essence supplies the non-human endpoint of the redirected account.
Sovereignty and ownership relocate the ultimate claim beyond interpersonal exchange.

structural_cues: 92:19 negates a favor being recompensed; 92:20 replaces that motive through an إِلَّا exception.
The focus warning is causative and addressed, which can carry the activated register of formal notice without requiring a literal legal translation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, compensation, branding, favor, recompense, debt collection, seeking, and sovereignty; I connect them into a legal-economic notice whose settlement exceeds human reciprocity. A live alternative is that 92:19-20 only purifies motive and never activates a liability metaphor in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The warning announces heat with no exchange structure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also sounds like notice of an account that no human favor, repayment, or ordinary compensation can discharge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeking, face/direction, sovereignty, and above form an upward intentional vector. The focus fire-beacon becomes its negative counterpart: the warning gives one bearing to avoid while the later phrase gives the bearing actively sought.

activation_trace.role: The warning communicates a negative bearing early enough for reorientation.
A beacon or boundary marker makes the fire the visible direction not to follow.
The active blaze keeps the negative landmark dynamically salient.
Active seeking supplies intentional movement toward the opposed goal.
Direction and orientation turn motive into a bearing.
Sovereignty identifies the personal goal governing that bearing.
The upper direction gives the sought vector a vertical dimension.

structural_cues: 92:20 packs seeking, face, lordship, and superlative height into one motive phrase.
The focus's direct warning and visible active fire can function as the opposed landmark within that directional syntax.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeking, direction, sovereignty, upper location, and a focus beacon; I polarize them as opposed bearings, one avoided and one sought. An alternative is that أَعْلَىٰ denotes rank alone, so no vertical geometry should be projected back onto the fire.

changed_reading.after: It is one pole in an orientational field: warning marks the bearing to refuse, while seeking the highest face supplies the positive bearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing satisfaction stands opposite the focus branches of flaring enmity and burning anger. This does not identify one subject for both states; it activates an affective spectrum in which blazing hostility and settled acceptance are rival terminal climates.

activation_trace.role: Enmity flaring among people supplies the social heat at one end of the spectrum.
A person burning with anger supplies an affective reading of the active blaze.
Satisfaction as the opposite of displeasure supplies the cool, settled counter-state.

structural_cues: تَلَظَّىٰ and يَرْضَىٰ are late, intransitive verbal closures with matching final ā cadence.
The surah moves from the active blaze near its warning to satisfaction in its final ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies anger, social enmity, and satisfaction branches plus a formal terminal echo; I infer an affective counterpoint but do not transfer grammatical agency from one verb to the other. A live alternative is that the two states belong to entirely separate semantic domains and only the rhyme links them.

changed_reading.before: The personified blaze is an isolated image of anger.
changed_reading.after: The closing satisfaction gives that heat a coexisting affective opposite: the sequence can move from flaring antagonism toward settled acceptance without making them the same agent's emotion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from ه د ي to a form-distant threat branch. It remains valid as a latent activation because 92:12 is immediately upstream of the focus warning and the packet explicitly preserves that mapped inventory. Downstream prose should call it a split-root echo inside guidance, never a lexical gloss of هُدَىٰ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَنذَرْ is itself a warning, and نَارًا can function as a route beacon; the upstream split cue adds threat as a shadow mode of guidance.

activation_trace.role: The explicit fear-awakening warning anchors the split-root threat echo in the focus.
The beacon image keeps the outlier tied to route-guidance rather than free-floating menace.
The non-dominant mapped branch of threat and warning lets guidance cast a severe cautionary shadow.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is gentle direction and warning is a separate harsh act.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root echo, the warning can be heard as guidance's threatening edge: the route is disclosed partly by showing its catastrophe.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because wound compensation and livestock branding are not the surface senses of the focus words. It remains anchored because both images occur in the complete focus inventories and combine through the explicit warning-fire syntax. Render only as a legal-material resonance—announced liability becoming a visible mark—not as a translation or settled doctrine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same focus construction joins a warning root with a compensation branch to a fire root with a branding branch, then intensifies the fire through تَلَظَّىٰ.

activation_trace.role: Compensation owed for a wound supplies the image of formally incurred liability.
Branding by burning fire turns liability into an embodied and publicly legible mark.
The pure blazing flame supplies the material force that makes the mark consequential.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces an unstructured physical danger.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it resembles formal notice of a liability whose fiery sanction leaves a visible mark.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain image is surprising because it activates the fire root's blossom branch and a non-dominant growth branch under ر ب ب. It remains anchored in نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ and gains context support from explicit growth/purification. Downstream prose should qualify it as an inverted-bloom analogy: flame flowers destructively while giving nourishes growth, not that نَار literally means blossom here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَارًا carries a branch of tree bloom while تَلَظَّىٰ gives that bloom a violently flaring form.

activation_trace.role: Tree blossom and bloom supply the shape of an unfolding, outward-opening fire.
Pure flaring flame converts bloom into a destructive rather than fertile unfolding.
Growth and increase provide the living counter-process to the flame's destructive flowering.
The non-dominant nourishment and development branch extends the contrast between cultivated growth and consuming bloom.

changed_reading.before: Blazing is only an increase in heat.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the fire can 'flower' into destructive visibility, opposed by the nourished growth activated through giving and purification.

strongest_changes: The night/day and guidance cues strengthen a negative-beacon reading: warning unveils and maps delayed danger rather than merely threatening it.
The mirrored ease/difficulty sequences revise the warning into an intervention inside a feedback fork, before a chosen route becomes easy to continue.
The post-focus restriction, turning, separation, and protection produce a selective contact geometry: everyone is warned, but orientation determines proximity to the blaze.
Giving, purification, non-repayment, and seeking preserve additional transformative and ledger-like readings alongside the direct punitive one.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three inventories are unusually generative together: warning can awaken caution or activate liability; fire can be blaze, beacon, recoil, hostility, brand, or bloom; and تَلَظَّىٰ makes the object active while also admitting an anger image. Context did not settle these into one sense. It organized them into coexisting perceptual, path-dependent, spatial, legal-economic, material, and affective models, with the split ه د ي inventory adding a carefully contained threat-inside-guidance echo.
remaining_uncertainties: The fall-to-flame geometry is coherent but its directional convergence is reader-supplied rather than stated.
The liability/brand and destructive-bloom readings are packet-backed activations, not secure surface glosses.
The anger-to-satisfaction counterpoint must keep agency unresolved; the packet does not make both verbs one subject's emotion.
The force of فَ in 92:14 may tightly bind warning to guidance and temporal ownership, or may mark a looser discourse consequence.
